faqs.answer: We review existing processes, records and documentation, identify gaps and establish practical HR systems that support your business as it grows.
Yes. Recruitment serves employers and candidates. Candidate enquiries go to hr@kanjayconsulting.com; employer enquiries go to info@kanjayconsulting.com.
We also support applicable statutory compliance activities and coordinate with your finance team or compliance specialists.
We develop practical HR policies, employee handbooks, appointment letters and other essential documents tailored to your organisation’s needs.
We help define Key Result Areas and Key Performance Indicators, establish appraisal processes and support performance reviews that bring clarity to expectations and accountability.
We support feedback initiatives, recognition programmes and engagement activities, helping you identify employee concerns and strengthen retention efforts.
We support joining formalities, induction coordination, exit procedures, clearance tracking and full and final settlement calculations for a smoother employee experience.
No. GeM consulting is for sellers, not government buyers.
We support category selection, specification entry, document uploads and catalogue creation to reflect your offerings accurately.
We review relevant bids, eligibility criteria, technical requirements and submission timelines to help you make informed participation decisions.
We assist with bid preparation, document uploads, submission and clarification responses, helping reduce avoidable errors.
We assist with document preparation, application coordination and follow-ups based on the requirements applicable to your business.
We review rejection remarks, identify gaps and assist with updates and resubmission to support the approval process.
We assist with order acceptance, contract requirement tracking, delivery coordination and portal invoicing, helping you manage commitments and follow-ups.
